newsitem.title: USA: Wang creates office of the president.
newsitem.headline: Wang creates office of the president.

text.p: Wang Laboratories Inc said Friday that it has created an office of the president, reporting to Chairman and Chief Executive Joseph Tucci.
Serving in the office of the president will be:
Jose Ofman, president and chief operating officer - Americas, and Mias van Vuuren, chief operating officer - International will serve in the Office of the President.
Ofman joins Wang from Electronic Data Systems Corp, where he most recently held the position of corporate vice president and group executive.
Van Vuuren joined Wang in 1993, as senior vice president and general manager for Europe, Africa and the Middle East and became president of international operations in 1994.
